why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Lithos Genesis event Go to the Genesis Bootstrapping section of Lithos to see the designated pools and the allocation.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Choose a wallet when Lithos asks, and accept its Terms of Use as part of connecting.
3 Step 3 : Pick a designated Genesis pool Choose one of the listed pools. Lithos says you can deposit in more than one, and its reward curve favors early depositors.
4 Step 4 : Add liquidity to the pool Deposit both assets of the pair as a liquidity provider. This earns Genesis points plus fees and bribes while your liquidity stays in the pool.
5 Step 5 : Track your points and claim Check your Genesis points and LITH allocation in the same interface. Claims are made there, split between veLITH and liquid LITH.
